calculator.title: GEO Score calculator
calculator.description: Scores press texts for generative engine optimisation — four weighted dimensions: numeric data, action verbs, structure, objectivity.
calculator.textPlaceholder: Paste the press article you want scored for generative engine optimisation…

errors.emptyText: Enter the text you want analysed

result.highlightHint: Highlighted fragments: numeric data, subjective words. Click a recommendation on the side to jump to the matching fragment.

history.title: History
history.description: The GEO Score analyses you have run — status, score and the full result for each of them.
history.emptyDescription: Analyse your first text in the Calculator — it will show up here once the result is saved.

columns.viewDetailsAria: View details of the analysis from {{date}}

detail.title: Analysis details
detail.description: The full result and the configuration used to compute it.
detail.notFoundDescription: The analysis does not exist or you do not have access to it.
detail.configHint: A snapshot of the weights, benchmarks, grade thresholds and word lists in force at the time of this analysis — later changes in Settings no longer affect the score already computed.
detail.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone — the analysis will disappear from history for good.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Dimension weights, benchmarks, grade thresholds and word lists — the calculator configuration shared across the whole instance.
settings.loadErrorMessage: Try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, contact your administrator.
settings.weightsDescription: Four weighted scoring dimensions — they must add up to 100%.
settings.benchmarksDescription: Reference points (Muck Rack report) and the minimum scores for grades A-D.
settings.wordListsDescription: Used by the action verb and objectivity analysers.
settings.advancedDescription: Bullet point regex patterns and false-positive exceptions — configuration for advanced users.
settings.resetConfirmBody: This overwrites the weights, benchmarks, grade thresholds and word lists of the SHARED calculator configuration — for every user of this instance, not only for you. This cannot be undone.

errors.resetFailed: Could not restore the default configuration

validation.weightSum: The weights have to add up to 100% (currently {{sum}}%)
validation.listNotEmpty: The list has to contain at least one entry
validation.emptyEntry: An empty entry is not allowed
